name: concretecms-mcp-server
description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that integrates with Concrete CMS's REST API

CONCRETE_CANONICAL_URL.title: Canonical URL
CONCRETE_CANONICAL_URL.description: The URL of your ConcreteCMS installation

CONCRETE_API_CLIENT_ID.title: API Integration Client ID
CONCRETE_API_CLIENT_ID.description: The Client ID of your ConcreteCMS integration

CONCRETE_API_CLIENT_SECRET.title: API Integration Client Secret
CONCRETE_API_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The Client Secret of your ConcreteCMS integration

CONCRETE_API_SCOPE.title: API Integration Client Scopes
CONCRETE_API_SCOPE.description: Space-separated list of API Integration Client scopes

HTTP_PORT.title: Sign-in Port
HTTP_PORT.description: The local port used during the sign-in: it must be the port of the Redirect URI of your ConcreteCMS integration

TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.title: Token Encryption Key
TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description:
A secret key used to encrypt the saved tokens (if empty, they are saved in plain text)
Generate with:
node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('base64'))"

CONCRETE_USER_ID.title: Token File Name
CONCRETE_USER_ID.description: The name used for the files where the tokens are saved

TOKEN_DIR.title: Token Directory
TOKEN_DIR.description: Base directory for storing tokens; per-site subdirectories are created automatically (default: ~/.concretecms-mcp/tokens)

CONCRETE_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP.title: Allow insecure HTTP
CONCRETE_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP.description: Allow connecting to a Concrete server over plain HTTP instead of HTTPS. For local/development instances only - never enable against a production server (default: false)

OAUTH_DEBUG.title: OAuth debug mode
OAUTH_DEBUG.description: Enable debug logging for OAuth flows (default: false)

CONCRETE_API_DEBUG.title: Concrete API debug mode
CONCRETE_API_DEBUG.description: Log Concrete REST requests and responses (method, URL, bodies, status) to the server log for troubleshooting. Sensitive fields are redacted and bodies truncated by default (default: false)

DEBUG_MAX_BODY.title: Debug body limit
DEBUG_MAX_BODY.description: Max number of characters logged for each request/response body in any debug output. Set to 0 to omit bodies from the log entirely (default: 2000)
